method_scopes.rationale: All operations apply to the Dey 2015 implementation. Inventory of all four inspected DR-Seq rows: the opening Single cell / RNA or polyA RNA / DNA icons identify the two biological targets; yellow highlighting is illustrative, not a chemical selection operation. The action route is single-cell lysis, barcoded RT, Ad-2 quasilinear co-amplification, splitting into two aliquots, then separate transcriptome and genome processing and sequencing. Purple/blue segments and green/magenta end segments distinguish drawn materials, but no chemical end groups are specified by those colors. The primary source identifies Ad-1x, Ad-2 and the RNA intermediate. Each branch has its own local sequencing Operation despite the shared Sequence caption. Neighboring Duplex-Seq, SIDR, G&T-seq, Hi-SCL, inDrop and partial Drop-seq rows and the adjacent structure drawing are outside the assigned target. gDNA-mRNA Sequencing is the primary paper’s expansion of DR-Seq, not an additional method. The named quasilinear amplification and small-RNA library procedures remain components rather than additional target methods.
